 'Siyou' debuts as TikTok creator…Kim Hyun-joong's ex-girlfriend, begins entertainment activities
 by. Jiho Kim
 10/21/2026 22:01 ET
 [Dispatch=Reporter Kim Ji-ho] A, the ex-girlfriend of singer and actor Kim Hyun-joong, has begun entertainment activities under the stage name 'SeeU'.
 The TikTok live agency 'LIGHTNING CENTRAL' stated on the 22nd to 'Dispatch', "It is correct that SeeU is active as a creator under our agency."
 SeeU opened a TikTok account last month and is already conducting active live interactions. She is also ranking in the upper positions of TikTok Live Daily Rankings.
 Starting with TikTok activities, she is planning to expand into various fields. LIGHTNING CENTRAL stated, "SeeU is planning diverse activities including beauty, health, and entertainment based on TikTok going forward."
 Regarding legal disputes with Kim Hyun-joong, they drew a line saying, "It is already all in the past." All lawsuits regarding custody and parental rights for the child have been concluded. They emphasized, "We will focus on the present and future."
 Regarding SeeU, they added, "She is a single mother with bright and positive energy, is versatile and has strong sense of responsibility. We ask for much interest in SeeU's activities going forward."
 SeeU dated Kim Hyun-joong for approximately three years starting in 2012. In September 2015, while in dispute with Kim Hyun-joong, she gave birth to Kim Hyun-joong's biological child. Since then, SeeU has been raising her son alone.
 Meanwhile, Kim Hyun-joong married a non-celebrity woman in 2022. That year he had a son.
